has_team_account_recovery.description: True if the team has enabled account recovery

has_biometric_reset.description: True if the user has enabled biometric reset on this device

is_first_login.description: True, when it’s the first authentication on this device. False otherwise. Also, must be sent only after successful login.

mode.description: The authentication mode in an app

reason.description: The reason why the user should authenticate

status.description: The status of the login (success or failure)

authentication_status.description: The authentication status of the user

two_factor_authentication_error.description: An error returned when changing the two factor authentication setting

has_authenticator_installed.description: True if the user already has the authenticator app installed when launching the password manager (mobile only). False if not.

authenticator_otp_codes_count.description: Number of OTP codes present in the authenticator app when it is already installed on the device. Null when the authenticator app is not installed.

verification_mode.description: The verification mode the user was asked to login with. email_token is the default one when the user adds a new device. OTP1 (= new_device) when the user has 2FA enabled, required when adding a new device. OTP2 (=login) when the user has 2FA enabled, required at every login. authenticator_app when the user has 2FA enabled and the Authenticator app. None when no verification mode.

is_backup_code.description: True if the user used a backup code to login or try to login. False if not.
